name: 彭尉祖
objective: This course provides a comprehensive study of convective heat transfer, focusing on the fundamentals of fluid flow, energy transport, and boundary layer theory. Both forced and natural convection are examined in detail, with emphasis on governing equations, similarity analysis, and engineering correlations. Applications to internal and external flows are highlighted to prepare students for solving real-world thermal problems.
schedule:
Week 1 : Overview of heat transfer
Week 2 : Introduction to convective heat transfer 
Week 3 : Governing equations I: conversation of mass and momentum
Week 4 : Governing equations II: energy transport
Week 5 : Boundary layer theory I: velocity boundary layer
Week 6 : Boundary layer theory II: thermal boundary layer 
Week 7 : Similarity solutions for laminar boundary layers
Week 8 : Midterm exam
Week 9 : Heat transfer over flat plate
Week 10 : Sucking and Blowing on flat plate
Week 11 : Pipe flow
Week 12 : Heat transfer of pipe flow
Week 13 : Natural convection I: vertical surface
Week 14 : Natural convection II: horizontal surface
Week 15 : Transition to turbulence
Week 16 : Turbulent boundary layer flow
Week 17 : Heat transfer in turbulent boundary layer flow
Week 18 : Final exam
materials: Adrian Bejan, “Convection Heat Transfer,” 2nd ed., ISBN 0-471-57972-6. John Wiley & Sons, Inc., New York, United States of America, 1995.
